title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: The late bloomer
hook: Who on your team is going to surprise you next year?
intro: One player is always a step behind.
statement: Kids develop on their own timelines.
q1: Do you give that player extra time and patience —
q2: or challenge them like everyone else?
q3: What will this player look like in two years?
t1: Every kid is different. But late bloomers stay in the game
t2: when someone believes in them now.
cta: Coaches — how do you support late bloomers?
ctaLines: Extra time or the same push?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who on your team is going to surprise you next year?
One player is always a step behind. They keep showing up anyway.
Kids develop on their own timelines.
Extra patience or the same challenge. There is no single right way.
How do you support late bloomers? Share your habit in the comments.
